moments.action: Tight reverse shots in a sunlit crowd: the dark-haired American teenager smirks, the blond jock in the purple jersey glares back. The last shot widens to show the jock flanked by teammates.
A whip pan rips off the purple jerseys onto a blonde girl in a white shirt watching from the crowd. Cutting back, the two boys start trading words, the jock's face hardening as he answers.
Onlookers packed around the cars gape and shout. The teenager answers from under open sky; by the end the crowd behind the jock is laughing at him and the teenager is grinning.
A wide shot sets the terms: the jock at one end of the crowd, the blonde girl standing apart at the other. Cut in close, the teenager is calm while the jock's look curdles.
One long take at a half-built housing tract: jersey-wearing boys crouch at a 'Shang-Ri-La Estates' billboard start line, then the camera swings to the dirt street as the cars tear away in dust.
A hand slams the shifter in a dim interior. Spectators dance on a pickup bed, then the jock is driving the red convertible with the blonde beside him and the teenager pulls level, glancing across.
The jock drops his eyes to the gauges as fans whoop on the pickup. The blonde twists round to look back at the chasing car, and the teenager breaks into a grin at his wheel.
Sky and lens flare as the cars crest a rise, then a low angle catches an undercarriage slamming down. Both drivers grip in: a fist yanks the shifter and the pair blast past the ground-level camera.

Side-on and then from behind inside the red convertible, the jock drives with the blonde silent next to him. The last shot pulls out wide: cream muscle car and convertible neck-and-neck between unfinished houses.
The teenager glares sideways, then his cracked-windshield POV runs down the tract road as scaffolding smears past. By the end both cars are closing on the spectators' pickup and the jock is shouting.
A boot stamps the pedal in the dark footwell. The cars sweep past the spectator pickup, a jersey-clad fan leaning out as they pass, and the final wide leaves the two cars dead level past the houses.
